ctx.x: This is all they did, they played all

day, just jammed all the time, all night long. And Edgar Hayes had the band there and let's see, the drummer was Kaiser Marshall. You never heard of him but he was a great drummer. But any way this is where we would go to cash our recording checks, and we would just stay right there and spend it. We wouldn't get out with a quarter.
But this was during the time -- this was during the war, you know. Early. Just before we came -- just before we became involved in it. You know the war had started over in Europe.
